payload.content:
name: port-authority-surge-response
description: 'Port authority surge-day exercise covering customs coordination, manifest
  integrity, yard OT disruption, and blackstart-style recovery of crane operations
  during a cargo spike.

  '
nodes:
  public-edge:
    type: switch
    description: Public shipping and partner ingress
  terminal-it:
    type: switch
    description: Terminal operating systems and portal tier
  customs-link:
    type: switch
    description: Customs and partner integration boundary
  yard-ot:
    type: switch
    description: Yard control and PLC zone
  safety-net:
    type: switch
    description: Safety and camera analytics zone
  vendor-net:
    type: switch
    description: Vendor maintenance path
  security-net:
    type: switch
    description: SOC monitoring network
  backup-net:
    type: switch
    description: Historian and backup network
  shipping-portal:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: portal-app
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 4294967296
      cpu: 2
    os: linux
    features:
      shipping-portal-app: portal-admin
    conditions:
      portal-healthy: portal-admin
    roles:
      portal-admin:
        username: portal
        entities:
        - port-blue.it
    services:
    - port: 443
      name: shipping-portal-https
  manifest-db:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: manifest-db
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 8589934592
      cpu: 4
    os: linux
    features:
      manifest-store: dba
    conditions:
      manifest-integrity-ok: dba
      tampered-manifest-observed: dba
    roles:
      dba:
        username: postgres
        entities:
        - port-blue.it
    services:
    - port: 5432
      name: manifest-postgres
    asset_value:
      integrity: critical
      availability: high
  terminal-ops:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: terminal-operating-system
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 6442450944
      cpu: 4
    os: linux
    features:
      terminal-service: tos-admin
    conditions:
      terminal-throughput-healthy: tos-admin
    roles:
      tos-admin:
        username: tosadmin
        entities:
        - port-blue.it
    services:
    - port: 443
      name: tos-https
  port-idp:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: port-idp
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 2147483648
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    features:
      port-sso: idp-admin
    conditions:
      port-sso-healthy: idp-admin
    roles:
      idp-admin:
        username: idpadmin
        entities:
        - port-blue.it
    services:
    - port: 443
      name: port-sso-https
  customs-gateway:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: customs-gateway
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 2147483648
      cpu: 2
    os: linux
    features:
      customs-api: customs-admin
    conditions:
      customs-link-healthy: customs-admin
    roles:
      customs-admin:
        username: customs
        entities:
        - customs-agency
    services:
    - port: 443
      name: customs-api-https
  yard-hmi:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: yard-hmi
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 4294967296
      cpu: 2
    os: windows
    os_distribution: windows-client
    os_version: '10'
    features:
      yard-hmi-app: hmi-admin
    conditions:
      crane-safe-mode: hmi-admin
      operator-visibility-healthy: hmi-admin
    roles:
      hmi-admin:
        username: craneops
        entities:
        - port-blue.yard-ops
    services:
    - port: 3389
      name: yard-hmi-rdp
    - port: 443
      name: yard-hmi-web
    asset_value:
      integrity: critical
      availability: critical
  crane-plc:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: crane-plc
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 536870912
      cpu: 1
    os: other
    features:
      crane-control: plc-admin
    conditions:
      crane-plc-online: plc-admin
    roles:
      plc-admin:
        username: plcsvc
    services:
    - port: 4840
      name: crane-opcua
  gate-kiosk:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: gate-kiosk
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 2147483648
      cpu: 1
    os: windows
    os_distribution: windows-client
    os_version: '11'
    conditions:
      gate-processing-healthy: kiosk-admin
    roles:
      kiosk-admin:
        username: kiosk
    services:
    - port: 443
      name: gate-kiosk-https
  camera-analytics:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: camera-analytics
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 4294967296
      cpu: 2
    os: linux
    features:
      camera-ai: camera-admin
    conditions:
      camera-analytics-healthy: camera-admin
    roles:
      camera-admin:
        username: camera
        entities:
        - port-blue.yard-ops
    services:
    - port: 443
      name: camera-analytics-ui
  historian01:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: ot-historian
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 4294967296
      cpu: 2
    os: linux
    features:
      historian-service: historian-admin
    conditions:
      yard-telemetry-flowing: historian-admin
      historian-replication-ok: historian-admin
    roles:
      historian-admin:
        username: historian
    services:
    - port: 443
      name: historian-ui
  vendor-jump:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: vendor-jump
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 2147483648
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    conditions:
      vendor-jump-healthy: vendor-admin
    roles:
      vendor-admin:
        username: vendor
        entities:
        - vendor-maintenance
    services:
    - port: 22
      name: vendor-jump-ssh
  soc01:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: siem-stack
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 8589934592
      cpu: 4
    os: linux
    features:
      port-siem: soc-admin
      yard-edr: soc-admin
    conditions:
      soc-feed-healthy: soc-admin
      surge-incident-ticketed: soc-admin
    roles:
      soc-admin:
        username: soc
        entities:
        - port-blue.incident-command
    services:
    - port: 5601
      name: port-soc-ui
  backup-vault:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: immutable-backup
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 4294967296
      cpu: 2
    os: linux
    features:
      yard-backup: backup-admin
    conditions:
      blackstart-runbook-ready: backup-admin
    roles:
      backup-admin:
        username: backup
        entities:
        - port-blue.incident-command
    services:
    - port: 443
      name: yard-backup-ui
infrastructure:
  public-edge:
    count: 1
    properties:
      cidr: 10.110.0.0/24
      gateway: 10.110.0.1
  terminal-it:
    count: 1
    properties:
      cidr: 10.110.1.0/24
      gateway: 10.110.1.1
      internal: true
  customs-link:
    count: 1
    properties:
      cidr: 10.110.2.0/24
      gateway: 10.110.2.1
  yard-ot:
    count: 1
    properties:
      cidr: 10.110.3.0/24
      gateway: 10.110.3.1
      internal: true
    acls:
    - name: allow-yard-control
      direction: in
      from_net: terminal-it
      protocol: tcp
      ports:
      - 443
      - 4840
      action: allow
    - name: deny-public-yard
      direction: in
      from_net: public-edge
      action: deny
  safety-net:
    count: 1
    properties:
      cidr: 10.110.4.0/24
      gateway: 10.110.4.1
      internal: true
  vendor-net:
    count: 1
    properties:
      cidr: 10.110.5.0/24
      gateway: 10.110.5.1
      internal: true
  security-net:
    count: 1
    properties:
      cidr: 10.110.6.0/24
      gateway: 10.110.6.1
      internal: true
  backup-net:
    count: 1
    properties:
      cidr: 10.110.7.0/24
      gateway: 10.110.7.1
      internal: true
  shipping-portal:
    count: 1
    links:
    - public-edge
    - terminal-it
    - customs-link
  manifest-db:
    count: 1
    links:
    - terminal-it
    - backup-net
    dependencies:
    - backup-vault
  terminal-ops:
    count: 1
    links:
    - terminal-it
    - customs-link
    - yard-ot
    dependencies:
    - manifest-db
    - port-idp
  port-idp:
    count: 1
    links:
    - terminal-it
    - customs-link
  customs-gateway:
    count: 1
    links:
    - customs-link
    - terminal-it
  yard-hmi:
    count: 1
    links:
    - yard-ot
    - safety-net
    dependencies:
    - terminal-ops
  crane-plc:
    count: 1
    links:
    - yard-ot
  gate-kiosk:
    count: 1
    links:
    - terminal-it
  camera-analytics:
    count: 1
    links:
    - safety-net
    - security-net
  historian01:
    count: 1
    links:
    - yard-ot
    - backup-net
    dependencies:
    - backup-vault
  vendor-jump:
    count: 1
    links:
    - vendor-net
    - yard-ot
  soc01:
    count: 1
    links:
    - security-net
    - terminal-it
  backup-vault:
    count: 1
    links:
    - backup-net
    - security-net
features:
  shipping-portal-app:
    type: service
    source:
      name: react-portal
      version: '*'
  manifest-store:
    type: service
    source:
      name: postgres-15
      version: '*'
  terminal-service:
    type: service
    source:
      name: tos-core
      version: '*'
  port-sso:
    type: service
    source:
      name: keycloak
      version: '*'
  customs-api:
    type: service
    source:
      name: customs-rest-bridge
      version: '*'
  yard-hmi-app:
    type: service
    source:
      name: yard-hmi
      version: '*'
  crane-control:
    type: service
    source:
      name: crane-plc
      version: '*'
  camera-ai:
    type: service
    source:
      name: vision-analytics
      version: '*'
  historian-service:
    type: service
    source:
      name: historian
      version: '*'
  port-siem:
    type: service
    source:
      name: wazuh-elastic-stack
      version: '*'
  yard-edr:
    type: artifact
    source:
      name: yard-edr-agent
      version: '*'
    destination: /opt/edr
  yard-backup:
    type: service
    source:
      name: immutable-backup
      version: '*'
conditions:
  portal-healthy:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-portal
    interval: 30
  manifest-integrity-ok:
    proposition: manifest-integrity-ok
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-manifest-integrity
    interval: 30
  tampered-manifest-observed:
    proposition: tampered-manifest-observed
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-tampered-manifest
    interval: 60
  terminal-throughput-healthy:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-terminal-throughput
    interval: 30
  port-sso-healthy:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-port-sso
    interval: 30
  customs-link-healthy:
    proposition: customs-link-healthy
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-customs-link
    interval: 30
  crane-safe-mode:
    proposition: crane-safe-mode
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-crane-safe-mode
    interval: 15
  operator-visibility-healthy:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-operator-visibility
    interval: 30
  crane-plc-online:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-crane-plc
    interval: 15
  gate-processing-healthy:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-gate-processing
    interval: 30
  camera-analytics-healthy:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-camera-analytics
    interval: 30
  yard-telemetry-flowing:
    proposition: yard-telemetry-flowing
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-yard-telemetry
    interval: 15
  historian-replication-ok:
    proposition: historian-replication-ok
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-historian-replication
    interval: 30
  vendor-jump-healthy:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-vendor-jump
    interval: 30
  soc-feed-healthy:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-soc-feed
    interval: 30
  surge-incident-ticketed:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-surge-ticket
    interval: 60
  blackstart-runbook-ready:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-blackstart-runbook
    interval: 60
propositions:
  crane-safe-mode:
    description: The governed crane-safe-mode observation is true for the addressed
      scenario subject.
    subjects:
    - nodes.yard-hmi
    basis: observed_state
    predicate:
      kind: boolean
      property: crane-safe-mode
      semantic_ref: urn:raes:observable:crane-safe-mode
      operator: equals
      expected: true
    quantifier: all
    evidence_requirements:
    - objective-truth-evidence
  customs-link-healthy:
    description: The governed customs-link-healthy observation is true for the addressed
      scenario subject.
    subjects:
    - nodes.customs-gateway
    basis: observed_state
    predicate:
      kind: boolean
      property: customs-link-healthy
      semantic_ref: urn:raes:observable:customs-link-healthy
      operator: equals
      expected: true
    quantifier: all
    evidence_requirements:
    - objective-truth-evidence
  historian-replication-ok:
    description: The governed historian-replication-ok observation is true for the
      addressed scenario subject.
    subjects:
    - nodes.historian01
    basis: observed_state
    predicate:
      kind: boolean
      property: historian-replication-ok
      semantic_ref: urn:raes:observable:historian-replication-ok
      operator: equals
      expected: true
    quantifier: all
    evidence_requirements:
    - objective-truth-evidence
  manifest-integrity-ok:
    description: The governed manifest-integrity-ok observation is true for the addressed
      scenario subject.
    subjects:
    - nodes.manifest-db
    basis: observed_state
    predicate:
      kind: boolean
      property: manifest-integrity-ok
      semantic_ref: urn:raes:observable:manifest-integrity-ok
      operator: equals
      expected: true
    quantifier: all
    evidence_requirements:
    - objective-truth-evidence
  tampered-manifest-observed:
    description: The governed tampered-manifest-observed observation is true for the
      addressed scenario subject.
    subjects:
    - nodes.manifest-db
    basis: observed_state
    predicate:
      kind: boolean
      property: tampered-manifest-observed
      semantic_ref: urn:raes:observable:tampered-manifest-observed
      operator: equals
      expected: true
    quantifier: all
    evidence_requirements:
    - objective-truth-evidence
  yard-telemetry-flowing:
    description: The governed yard-telemetry-flowing observation is true for the addressed
      scenario subject.
    subjects:
    - nodes.historian01
    basis: observed_state
    predicate:
      kind: boolean
      property: yard-telemetry-flowing
      semantic_ref: urn:raes:observable:yard-telemetry-flowing
      operator: equals
      expected: true
    quantifier: all
    evidence_requirements:
    - objective-truth-evidence
assertions:
  crane-safe-mode:
    proposition: crane-safe-mode
    role: postcondition
    polarity: positive
  customs-link-healthy:
    proposition: customs-link-healthy
    role: postcondition
    polarity: positive
  historian-replication-ok:
    proposition: historian-replication-ok
    role: postcondition
    polarity: positive
  manifest-integrity-ok:
    proposition: manifest-integrity-ok
    role: postcondition
    polarity: positive
  tampered-manifest-observed:
    proposition: tampered-manifest-observed
    role: postcondition
    polarity: positive
  yard-telemetry-flowing:
    proposition: yard-telemetry-flowing
    role: postcondition
    polarity: positive
  pre-tampered-manifest-observed:
    proposition: tampered-manifest-observed
    role: precondition
    polarity: positive
entities:
  port-blue:
    name: Port Authority Blue Team
    role: blue
    mission: Maintain customs integrity and safe yard operations during the surge
    entities:
      it:
        name: Port IT
      yard-ops:
        name: Yard Operations
      incident-command:
        name: Incident Command
  customs-agency:
    name: Customs Agency
    role: green
    mission: Clear inbound cargo without compromising compliance
  vendor-maintenance:
    name: Vendor Maintenance
    role: green
    mission: Maintain remote support path for crane systems
  red-cartel:
    name: Red Cartel
    role: red
    mission: Corrupt manifests and degrade crane operations
  white-cell:
    name: White Cell
    role: white
injects:
  surge-brief:
    source:
      name: surge-day-brief
      version: '*'
    from_entity: white-cell
    to_entities:
    - port-blue
    - customs-agency
    description: Cargo surge and priority humanitarian shipments announced
  customs-priority-ticket:
    source:
      name: customs-priority-ticket
      version: '*'
    from_entity: customs-agency
    to_entities:
    - port-blue
    description: High-priority manifest validation request
  safety-standdown:
    source:
      name: safety-standdown-order
      version: '*'
    from_entity: white-cell
    to_entities:
    - port-blue
    - vendor-maintenance
    description: Crane anomalies trigger a safety standdown
events:
  vessel-arrival:
    injects:
    - surge-brief
  customs-surge-event:
    injects:
    - customs-priority-ticket
  yard-standdown:
    assertions:
    - pre-tampered-manifest-observed
    injects:
    - safety-standdown
scripts:
  arrival-phase:
    start_time: 0
    end_time: 7200
    speed: 1.0
    events:
      vessel-arrival: 900
  customs-surge-phase:
    start_time: 7200
    end_time: 14400
    speed: 1.0
    events:
      customs-surge-event: 9000
  yard-disruption-phase:
    start_time: 14400
    end_time: 25200
    speed: 1.0
    events:
      yard-standdown: 18000
stories:
  surge-day:
    scripts:
    - arrival-phase
    - customs-surge-phase
    - yard-disruption-phase
content:
  cargo-manifests:
    type: dataset
    target: manifest-db
    source:
      name: cargo-manifest-seed
      version: '*'
    format: csv
    sensitive: true
  hazmat-list:
    type: file
    target: terminal-ops
    path: /srv/tos/hazmat-list.csv
    text: container_id,classification\nHZ-204,flammable\nHZ-991,oxidizer
    sensitive: true
  customs-holds:
    type: dataset
    target: customs-gateway
    format: json
    items:
    - name: hold-hz-204
      display_name: hold-HZ-204.json
      tags:
      - customs
      - hold
      description: Hold order for hazardous container HZ-204
    - name: hold-hz-991
      display_name: hold-HZ-991.json
      tags:
      - customs
      - hold
      description: Hold order for hazardous container HZ-991
  yard-camera-clips:
    type: dataset
    target: camera-analytics
    source:
      name: yard-camera-clip-seed
      version: '*'
    format: mp4
    sensitive: true
  blackstart-runbook:
    type: file
    target: backup-vault
    path: /srv/runbooks/yard-blackstart.md
    text: Re-establish historian, validate PLC, then return HMI to service.
    sensitive: true
accounts:
  harbor-master:
    username: harbor.master
    node: terminal-ops
    groups:
    - Operations
    password_strength: strong
  customs-officer:
    username: customs.officer
    node: customs-gateway
    groups:
    - Customs
    password_strength: strong
  crane-operator:
    username: crane.ops
    node: yard-hmi
    groups:
    - YardOps
    password_strength: medium
  vendor-tech:
    username: vendor
    node: vendor-jump
    groups:
    - Vendors
    password_strength: medium
  tos-service:
    username: tos_svc
    node: terminal-ops
    groups:
    - AppServices
    password_strength: weak
  historian-svc:
    username: hist_svc
    node: historian01
    groups:
    - Historian
    password_strength: medium
  soc-analyst:
    username: socanalyst
    node: soc01
    groups:
    - SOC
    password_strength: strong
relationships:
  portal-to-manifest:
    type: connects_to
    source: shipping-portal-app
    target: manifest-store
    properties:
      protocol: tcp
      port: '5432'
  terminal-auth-portidp:
    type: authenticates_with
    source: terminal-service
    target: port-sso
  customs-federates-port:
    type: federates_with
    source: customs-api
    target: port-sso
    properties:
      protocol: OIDC
  hmi-manages-crane:
    type: manages
    source: yard-hmi-app
    target: crane-control
  historian-replicates-backup:
    type: replicates_to
    source: historian-service
    target: yard-backup
  vendor-support-path:
    type: authenticates_with
    source: vendor-tech
    target: yard-hmi
  terminal-depends-customs:
    type: depends_on
    source: terminal-service
    target: customs-api
agents:
  red-yard-agent:
    affiliations:
    - red-cartel
    actions:
    - phish
    - tamper
    - disable
    - pivot
    initial_knowledge:
      hosts:
      - shipping-portal
      - vendor-jump
      - yard-hmi
      subnets:
      - public-edge
      - vendor-net
      - yard-ot
      services:
      - shipping-portal-https
      - vendor-jump-ssh
      - yard-hmi-web
      accounts:
      - vendor-tech
    allowed_subnets:
    - public-edge
    - vendor-net
    - yard-ot
    - terminal-it
  blue-yard-agent:
    affiliations:
    - port-blue.yard-ops
    actions:
    - inspect
    - isolate
    - restore
    - validate
    starting_accounts:
    - crane-operator
    initial_knowledge:
      hosts:
      - yard-hmi
      - crane-plc
      - historian01
      subnets:
      - yard-ot
      - backup-net
      - safety-net
      services:
      - yard-hmi-rdp
      - crane-opcua
      - historian-ui
      accounts:
      - historian-svc
    allowed_subnets:
    - yard-ot
    - safety-net
    - backup-net
  blue-soc-agent:
    affiliations:
    - port-blue.incident-command
    actions:
    - monitor
    - triage
    - coordinate
    - recover
    starting_accounts:
    - soc-analyst
    initial_knowledge:
      hosts:
      - soc01
      - shipping-portal
      - terminal-ops
      subnets:
      - security-net
      - terminal-it
      services:
      - port-soc-ui
      - shipping-portal-https
      - tos-https
      accounts:
      - harbor-master
      - customs-officer
    allowed_subnets:
    - security-net
    - terminal-it
    - customs-link
    - backup-net
action_contracts:
  coordinate:
    semantic_version: 1.0.0
    behavioral_granularity: atomic
    procedure_basis: Scenario-declared Coordinate intent
    realization_profile: abstract
    fidelity_claim: Portable intent only; no backend procedure, successful effect,
      or authority is asserted.
    preconditions:
    - precondition_id: authorized
      precondition_class: authority
      description: Independent authorization is required before any realization.
    effects:
    - effect_id: intended
      effect_class: intended_effect
      description: Attempt Coordinate against the scenario-declared subject set.
      target_refs:
      - customs-federates-port
      - customs-gateway
      - manifest-db
    failure_classes:
    - authority_denied
    - target_unavailable
    - unknown

evidence_requirements:
  objective-truth-evidence:
    description: Capture evidence used to decide authored proposition assertions.
    source_refs:
    - nodes.manifest-db
    - nodes.historian01
    - nodes.customs-gateway
    - nodes.yard-hmi
    scope: authored objective, event, workflow, and participant assertion evaluation
    boundary_kind: assertion_evaluation
    channel: log
    artifact_role: proposition_truth_evidence
    media_types:
    - application/json
    sensitivity: plain
    redaction: redact_secrets
    integrity: checksum
    retention: study_lifetime
    loss_disclosure: required
objectives:
  red-corrupt-manifests:
    assigned_participant: red-yard-agent
    actions:
    - phish
    - tamper
    targets:
    - cargo-manifests
    - manifest-db
    - portal-to-manifest
    success:
      assertions:
      - tampered-manifest-observed
    window:
      stories:
      - surge-day
      scripts:
      - arrival-phase
      - customs-surge-phase
  red-degrade-yard-ops:
    owner: red-cartel
    targets:
    - yard-hmi
    - crane-plc
    - hmi-manages-crane
    success:
      assertions:
      - tampered-manifest-observed
    window:
      stories:
      - surge-day
      scripts:
      - yard-disruption-phase
      events:
      - yard-standdown
    depends_on:
    - red-corrupt-manifests
  blue-maintain-customs-integrity:
    assigned_participant: blue-soc-agent
    actions:
    - monitor
    - triage
    - coordinate
    targets:
    - customs-gateway
    - manifest-db
    - customs-federates-port
    success:
      assertions:
      - customs-link-healthy
      - manifest-integrity-ok
    window:
      stories:
      - surge-day
      scripts:
      - arrival-phase
      - customs-surge-phase
      workflows:
      - yard-recovery
      steps:
      - yard-recovery.maintain-integrity
  blue-blackstart-yard:
    assigned_participant: blue-yard-agent
    actions:
    - inspect
    - isolate
    - restore
    - validate
    targets:
    - backup-vault
    - historian01
    - yard-hmi
    - historian-replicates-backup
    - nodes.crane-plc.services.crane-opcua
    - infrastructure.yard-ot.acls.allow-yard-control
    success:
      assertions:
      - crane-safe-mode
      - yard-telemetry-flowing
    window:
      stories:
      - surge-day
      scripts:
      - yard-disruption-phase
      events:
      - yard-standdown
      workflows:
      - yard-recovery
      steps:
      - yard-recovery.restore-yard
    depends_on:
    - blue-maintain-customs-integrity
    - red-degrade-yard-ops
  blue-validate-yard-telemetry:
    assigned_participant: blue-yard-agent
    actions:
    - inspect
    - validate
    targets:
    - historian01
    - camera-analytics
    - nodes.historian01.services.historian-ui
    - infrastructure.yard-ot.acls.allow-yard-control
    success:
      assertions:
      - yard-telemetry-flowing
      - historian-replication-ok
    window:
      stories:
      - surge-day
      scripts:
      - yard-disruption-phase
      events:
      - yard-standdown
      workflows:
      - yard-recovery
      steps:
      - yard-recovery.validate-telemetry
    depends_on:
    - red-degrade-yard-ops
workflows:
  yard-recovery:
    description: 'Recovery workflow that preserves customs integrity, branches into
      blackstart-style OT recovery when tampering is observed, and joins yard restoration
      with telemetry validation before declaring finish.

      '
    start: maintain-integrity
    steps:
      maintain-integrity:
        type: objective
        objective: blue-maintain-customs-integrity
        on_success: assess-yard
      assess-yard:
        type: decision
        when:
          assertions:
          - pre-tampered-manifest-observed
        then: fanout-blackstart
        else: finish
      fanout-blackstart:
        type: parallel
        branches:
        - restore-yard
        - validate-telemetry
        join: blackstart-joined
      restore-yard:
        type: objective
        objective: blue-blackstart-yard
        on_success: blackstart-joined
      validate-telemetry:
        type: objective
        objective: blue-validate-yard-telemetry
        on_success: blackstart-joined
      blackstart-joined:
        type: join
        next: finish
      finish:
        type: end
